home.hero_description: TRINETRA is an intelligent, offline-first outdoor safety and emergency response ecosystem. Combining on-device sensor fusion, contact-free camera PPG vitals, voice triage, and autonomous multi-agent rescue coordination.
home.feature1_desc: Autonomous multi-phase inertial monitoring detects free-falls followed by hard impact and subsequent inactivity, initiating automatic SOS if unresponsive.
home.feature2_desc: Zero-hardware pulse estimation using smartphone camera frames, bandpass filtering, and spectral peak analysis for rapid on-trail physiological checks.
home.feature3_desc: Specialized backend agents concurrently evaluate hospitals, medical severity, extraction corridors, SAR coordination, and bilingual alert drafting.
home.feature4_desc: Cellular and offline SQLite sync ensures critical alert payloads reach emergency contacts and mountain rescue responders without delay.
